text:
Maya (CS): FYI — BigAcme (acct: ACME-001) reports their enterprise contract credit (Q4-2025 promo) wasn't applied to their Feb invoices. They filed a Zendesk ticket ZD-4821. PO attached has note 'CONTRACT#Q4-ACME-2025: APPLY_CREDIT'. They say balance didn't change after we supposedly approved the credit on 2025-02-10.
Lee (Sales): thanks — Sophie added the PO to the contract last week. AE note said 'apply $10,000 credit across Feb invoices'. I thought SalesOps queued that? @Arjun (Finance) any visibility?
Arjun (Finance): I checked the ledger. No pending journal or credit memos for ACME-001. Our billing ingestion maps a 'billing_note' field on the PO/invoice to auto-apply contract promos. PO notes don't map automatically to that field. Can you paste the PO text and the invoice numbers we need to adjust?
Sophie (AE): excerpt from PO: "PO #98765, note: CONTRACT#Q4-ACME-2025: APPLY_CREDIT" — invoices: INV-2025-02-11, INV-2025-02-25. Zendesk: https://redwood.zendesk.com/agent/tickets/4821
Ben (Ops): Repro steps for the Billing Console (requires billing-admin role):
```
1. Billing Console -> Accounts -> ACME-001
2. Invoices tab -> filter INV-2025-02-11, INV-2025-02-25
3. Click 'Adjust' -> 'Create credit memo' -> set amount $10,000 -> link to contract ID C-2025-009
4. Save -> confirm ledger entry JE-20250210-ACME
```
Note: the UI will reject if you don't select 'apply to multiple invoices' when invoice amounts differ.
Arjun (Finance): Alternatively I can create manual journal and apply it: need exact amounts per invoice and GL mapping. For the journal route I'll create JE-2025-02-CM with GLs: 4001 (Revenue reversal), 2400 (Customer credit).
Maya (CS): Customer is waiting for statement update and a confirmation email. Will coordinate comms once credit is posted.
billing-bot: Ticket ZD-4821 updated by Sophie (AE) — status: escalated_to_billing
Lee (Sales): Can we update contract ingestion so PO tokens like 'CONTRACT#...' are parsed into billing_note? That would avoid manual ops.
Ben (Ops): +1. I'll open an infra task to add a lightweight parser in SalesOps ingestion to map CONTRACT# tokens into billing_note for future PO imports. For this case Arjun — can you do the manual journal? If approvals needed, I'll loop in finance-lead.
Arjun (Finance): I'll prepare the JE and apply today. ETA ~3 hours. I'll post the journal id and ledger screenshot here when done.
Sophie (AE): I'll send the confirmation email to the customer once Arjun confirms. Template: "We have applied a $10,000 contractual credit to your Feb invoices (INV-2025-02-11, INV-2025-02-25). Ledger reference: JE-2025-02-CM-<id>." :thumbsup:
Maya (CS): Marking this thread active until Arjun confirms. @billing-bot please add tag 'enterprise-credit-manual'
billing-bot: Tag added: enterprise-credit-manual
Arjun (Finance): Done. Journal created JE-2025-02-CM-172500; applied to INV-2025-02-11 (6,000) and INV-2025-02-25 (4,000). Ledger entry: https://redwood.internal/ledger/JE-2025-02-CM-172500
Sophie (AE): Emailed customer with the confirmation and ledger ref.
Maya (CS): Customer replied: "Thanks — confirmed credit is reflected on our statement."
Lee (Sales): Great work team. We'll keep the infra task open and close this thread after 24h. :party:
